node.statement: Fix s and let U lie in calU intersect B_{r_iso}(sJ) with sigma(U)=U. By the ambient-chart containment from lem-stage1-bound-quotient-local-index there is A=psi_s(U) in B_{r_iso}^{icalH}(0) with U=chi_s(A); hence F_s(A)=psi_s(sigma(chi_s(A)))=psi_s(U)=A and G_s(A)=0.
